pages.title: Cargo on a Shell
pages.text: Tame Carbonemys, equip its satchel and retrieve one item from its storage.

pages.title: Cargo on a Shell
pages.text: Hide supports further carrying equipment and cooked fillets provision the owner on a longer journey.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find Carbonemys in Cerrejon and use clams for taming. Fit its satchel and sneak-use to open storage. The native satchel also supports long expeditions.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Craft pelt-based grass or seed pouches and offer them to supported herbivores. Pouches support taming or breeding according to species.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Craft the native satchel using its material recipe. The guide describes in-inventory storage for long expeditions.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Find Carbonemys in the Cerrejon formation, tame it with clams and equip a satchel; sneak-use opens inventory. The large turtle carries resources as a companion.
